about_the_game:
In June 2025, let's set off with "Whale & Sky"!

An unheard - of marine future city!
Welcome to the marine future city - Whale Sky City!
This is a third - person shooting game. You will become a member of the Whale Sky Task Force and carry out the tasks given to you by Lynn!
There are many enemies in Whale Sky City who have been infected with an unknown special virus and harm citizens. You need to use special firearms to make the enemies free from the control of the virus!

Novel and fun diverse gameplay!
You are about to start your citizen life in Whale Sky City: become a barista, a chef, a photographer... Obtain necessary props in the field you like!

Two optional images and personalities for you!
As the member of the Whale Sky Task Force, you will enter the "Fantasy Dimension"! You can choose one of the two characters to be your image in Whale Sky!

Chat with Whale Sky citizens with different options!
Let's get to know everyone in Whale Sky together and become friends with these amazing and interesting characters! Your personality will determine different options during the chat!

More interesting content will be added as the game is updated! Please support me!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or newer, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 580 / AMD HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: "Whale & Sky" is a third-person shooter set in a futuristic ocean city. As a special agent, you arrive at the floating metropolis Whale Sky City — to hunt down enemies.
